ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) with a macro-level ratio of approximately 95:5 black to white pixels, with high-intensity pixels localized at the distal tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Solid dark pigmentation across the primary ventral surface; distinct high-contrast white circular clusters are localized at the far-left and far-right distal tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Calculated as a shallow V-shaped depression with an approximate pixel angle of 135 degrees and a low-depth bounding box relative to total lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous high-frequency, low-amplitude serrations (peaks and valleys) along the entire boundary; serration amplitude increases slightly toward the distal extremities.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve fitting observed from the median notch extending to the distal tips of both the left and right lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatially dense clusters of circular, high-contrast white pixel formations located at the extreme lateral margins of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Localized white barnacle colonies present on the distal tips of the fluke.
